strengths: Hook to meaning to question reads as one thought: leading vs. following, then who you could back.
Horse and threshing-farmer plates are period-appropriate readings of Kun (the Receptive) and of "supporting is its own strength."
Hexagram build and end card are clean, on-brand, and hold long enough to read.

changes.change: Drop the whip-up/whip-left/whip-right pattern on the meaning, question, and screen cuts; use straight cuts or soft zooms instead, saving any whip for the drop only.
changes.why: The track is tagged energy class calm at a flat 4-7 throughout; whipping on every beat reads as a driving-track cut style and fights the music instead of following it.

changes.change: Replace or crop the Jiao Yanshou verse block under "THE BOOK OF CHANGES" with a single short line (e.g. the hexagram pairing name), or hold the screen longer than 3.3 s if the quote stays.
changes.why: Five lines of caption-sized text, some in a second script, can't be read in the time given, so the screen shows without teaching anything.

changes.change: Drop the chromatic-aberration/glitch treatment on the "THE BOOK OF CHANGES" headline or reduce it to a subtler version used elsewhere in the series.
changes.why: The red/green fringing makes the headline harder to read than the clean type used on the other three screens.

review.notes: Check in motion whether the mid-whip frame at the drop (the "The Rece" clip in still 09) ever lands as a held frame instead of blur — the still suggests it's transitional, but worth confirming at playback speed. Also confirm the audio drop itself is felt as a lift, since the energy table only shows a jump from 4 to 6 rather than a hard hit.
